name: Milena Petrović
bio:
Milena's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during a university project focused on aerodynamics. Fascinated by the intricacies of airflow and its impact on vehicle performance, she pursued a master's degree specializing in wind tunnel technology. After graduating, Milena secured a position at a smaller racing team, where she honed her skills and developed a reputation for meticulous data analysis.

Joining Full Time Sports was a significant step in her career. She approaches her role with unwavering dedication, believing that even the smallest adjustments can make a significant difference on the track. Milena is known for her rigorous testing protocols and her ability to identify subtle areas for improvement that others might overlook. She is driven by a pursuit of perfection and a deep understanding of the complex interplay between aerodynamics and racing success.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair usually tied back in a neat ponytail to keep it out of her face while working.
physical.description: Milena is of average height with a focused and intense gaze.

quirks: Insists on using only metric units in all calculations and discussions.
Always has a small notebook and pen on hand to jot down observations during wind tunnel runs.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning the wind tunnel control panel before each session.
